page: Microsoft Azure EC4eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by an x86_64 Intel processor and managed through the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, resulting in an 8.0 GB per core allocation ratio. It features 236 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage and supports Azure Premium Storage. The hardware profile includes zero discrete graphics processing units and allocates no complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The physical resource allocation establishes a clear focus on memory-dense tasks that benefit from rapid ephemeral I/O. The integrated 236 GB NVMe SSD delivers direct-attached low-latency storage for temporary tables, caches, and swap files. Because the instance pairs a standard compute allocation of 4 vCPUs with an elevated memory profile, compute-bound workloads may experience execution limits before exhausting available memory capacity.

In qualitative terms, the EC4eds_v6 provides solid cost efficiency for memory-sensitive deployments by offering an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio alongside integrated NVMe hardware, avoiding the need to scale up to higher vCPU tiers merely to satisfy memory demands. This profile is appropriate for in-memory databases, intermediate caching tiers, relational database engines, ETL batch transformations, and data analysis pipelines requiring low-latency scratch disks.
